description: A 12HP expander for the FroeZe sequencer, placed immediately to its right: it gives every track its own accent output jack and adds pattern and track editing pages.

params.text: Sets whatever the message below it names, which changes with the page: TRACK, PATTERN, STEPS, PULSES, OFFSET and so on
Picks the command printed beside it on the screen; which command that is depends on the page, and clicking the matching box on the screen does the same thing

outputs.text: Carries the accents of that track: a +10V 1ms trigger on each accented step, or a gate held for as long as the drum sample plays when FroeZe's outputs are set to Audio Engine
Carries the accent track's own events as a +10V 1ms trigger

notes: the expander works only touching the right edge of a FroeZe module. Attached, it takes that module's panel model and display brightness and lights its screens; detached, the screens go dark
the euclidean page erases the selected track as soon as STEPS, PULSES or OFFSET is moved, and the auto-completion page can write over events already there. Save the pattern first.
a track can be copied only onto a track of the same kind: an instrument track onto another instrument track, the accent track onto another accent track.
this expander has no menu of its own beyond the licence line; the panel model and the sequencer's settings are on the FroeZe module's menu.
